about:
Based in Mediapolis, Iowa, Precision Resistive Products (PRP) has spent nearly five decades manufacturing precision resistors. The company marks 47 years of service, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed. Ownership details and founder names have not been shared.

PRP produces standard and non-standard valued resistors in both leaded and surface-mount packages. Its portfolio spans thin film, wire wound, thick film, metal film, power resistors, metal strip, shunts, current-sense, surge, pulse-withstanding, and metal oxide types. Recent additions include the GMR Series of aluminum-housed power wire-wound resistors (5 to 300 watts) and the AEC-Q200-qualified PTNF Series tantalum nitride thin-film chip resistors, alongside the PR9544 ultra-precise thin-film network chip and the PR9372 leaded metal-film audio series.

The company explicitly serves the automotive sector with AEC-Q200-compliant components. Its resistor lines also support broader electronics applications, though specific industry verticals beyond automotive are not detailed in the available information.

PRP emphasizes high quality, competitive pricing, and quick delivery as its operational pillars. The 47-year track record underscores a focus on reliability and customer service, with the firm highlighting its broad product range and ability to supply both standard and custom values.
